meta.name: Scribefloat Design System
meta.product: Scribefloat — local audio transcription for macOS

weightsOmitted.300: too light on dark backgrounds — omitted entirely

meta.tone: instrument-grade. terse, precise, zero hype. reads like terminal output.

casing.cta: Title Case (Stop and Save, Record Again)
casing.never: Title Case for labels or section headers

colors.description: OKLCH-based palette. Dark mode is default. Single-source knobs: --brand-hue shifts all brand colors; --canvas-l shifts the dark-mode surface scale. State tokens (warning, active, destructive, success, focus) are first-class and unrestricted in number per screen.

sourceKnobs.--brand-hue: 250 — change to shift ALL brand-tinted colors (both dark and light modes)
sourceKnobs.--canvas-l: 0.20 — dark-mode only; all 5 surface steps derive from this via calc()

active.role: Selected tab, active toggle track, option highlight

destructive.role: Delete / danger actions, recording status dot

brand.note: Lightness lowered for contrast on white

typography.rule: Geist for prose and UI labels. Geist Mono for anything that reads like an instrument readout — if it would look right on a terminal or piece of equipment, use Mono.
typography.weightRule: No bold. Hierarchy via size, case, and opacity only. Never font-weight 600 or 700.

display-lg.usage: Recording timer only. One instance per screen.

headline-sm.usage: Modal titles, screen-level headers. One per view.

body-md.usage: Transcript body, descriptions, onboarding prose, accordion content.

label-md.usage: Form field labels, accordion titles, button text, inline control labels.

label-sm.usage: Section dividers, metadata captions, status labels.

label-sm-mono.usage: File sizes, model names, hotkey chips, version strings, data labels.

spacing.description: Dense UI. Base unit is p-3 (12px). Use flex/grid with gap — never margin on siblings.

1.usage: Internal icon padding. Gap between dot and label. Chip inner spacing.

2.usage: Icon button padding. Gap between label and value. Within a form field row.

3.usage: Panel section padding. Note card padding. Gap between form fields. Modal body.

4.usage: Panel header horizontal padding. Modal header. Main CTA footer zone.

6.usage: Onboarding step padding. Between major layout zones (left/right split).

8.usage: Onboarding illustration breathing room. Never inside a Scribe panel.

omitted: anything above 8 inside the Scribe window
rules: Always use flex/grid with gap for sibling spacing — never margin between siblings
p-3 is the base unit inside panels
Keep horizontal padding consistent per zone — p-3 or p-4, never mixed
Max spacing inside Scribe window is p-8

sm.usage: Chips, small tags, status dot containers, inner elements within cards

md.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, panels, modals — everything else

full.usage: Toggle knob and recording status dot only. Nothing else.

rules: No pill buttons
No rounded modals beyond rounded-md
4px maximum on all interactive elements — this is an instrument, not a consumer app

ambient.usage: PanelShell floating window only. No shadow on cards or modals.

rules: Elevation is communicated by surface lightness steps, not shadow
Only the top-level floating panel uses a shadow
Cards, modals, and inner panels: no shadow

principles: Build every screen in grey first. Add a state color only when it carries meaning.

Each token has a semantic job. brand = primary action. focus = keyboard focus ring. destructive = danger. warning = caution. active = selected / on state. success = done. They are not interchangeable.
State tokens (warning, active, destructive, success, focus) may appear freely — there is no per-screen cap. Use as many as the content warrants.
Use opacity variants (fg/60, fg/40) to dim text. Do not tint surfaces with brand or state colors.
Iterate quickly: change --brand-hue in :root to shift the entire brand palette. Change --canvas-l to shift all dark-mode surfaces.

use: Primary action button (Stop and Save, Record)
Status indicators that need attention but are not errors

active.job: Selected UI state and on-state surfaces (not the keyboard focus ring)

use: Global :focus ring via ring-focus (see src/app.css @layer base)

success.note: Prefer transient use (auto-dismiss), but persistent success badges are allowed when the state is meaningful.

violations.fix: Use fg-dim (oklch 0.60) for idle bars; fg at 40% opacity for active bars

violations.bad: Permission cards with persistent success border + tint
violations.fix: Use fill border for permission rows. Show success check icon only.

violations.bad: Multiple warning-outlined actions on one screen with no hierarchy
violations.fix: Demote lower-priority actions to ghost. At most one attention-driving outline per zone; use normal (border-rim) for the rest.

violations.bad: Title input focus underline in brand color
violations.fix: Rely on the global focus ring (focus token / ring-focus in app.css), or a neutral rim underline — never brand for focus.

principles: No bold text in the UI. Hierarchy comes from size, case, and opacity — not weight.
If you reach for bold to add emphasis, add spacing or case instead.
Geist Mono for anything that reads like an instrument readout. Geist for everything else.
300 weight is removed entirely — too light on dark backgrounds.
Uppercase + tracking-stamped (0.05em) is a single visual treatment — always use them together.
Use flex/grid with gap for all sibling spacing — never margin on siblings.
p-3 is the base unit inside panels.
Keep horizontal padding consistent per zone — do not mix p-3 and p-4 within the same panel.
Never use spacing values outside the defined scale (no p-5, p-7, p-9, p-10).

surfaces.elevationModel: Lighter surface = higher elevation (dark mode). Darker surface = higher elevation (light mode). Never use shadow or border weight to indicate elevation.
surfaces.waveform: Use fg-dim (0.60) for idle waveform bars — not rim (0.40). On canvas background, rim has ~2:1 contrast (near invisible). fg-dim gives ~3.5:1.
principles: canvas is never used as a card or container surface for inner chrome — window / page only
Elevation is communicated purely by background lightness — no shadows on inner elements
No colored surface tints (no green/red/orange at low opacity as persistent backgrounds)

button.description: Five variants implemented in src/lib/components/Button.svelte. No separate yellow-outline secondary; use normal (border-rim) or ghost for non-primary actions.
rules: Max one primary (brand-filled) button per screen
Font: Geist Sans for all variants in the component (tracking-stamped on primary only)
Radius: rounded-md (4px) always
Heights: normal size h-10; small size h-6
No pill or full-round buttons

primary.tw: bg-brand text-on-brand tracking-stamped rounded-md hover:bg-brand-hover hover:text-on-brand-hover
primary.usage: The single most important action on screen

normal.tw: bg-transparent border border-rim text-fg font-sans rounded-md hover:bg-fill

active.usage: Pressed/segmented control active slot (see in-app usage)

iconButton.description: Square button for icons only. Must have aria-label.
rules: Always include aria-label
Never use without an accessible label

toggle.description: On/off switch. Active (blue) track when on, panel when off. Knob is full-round; on-state knob uses on-brand fill.

tw.track: relative inline-flex h-6 w-10 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border transition-colors
tw.knob: absolute left-1 h-4 w-4 rounded-full transition-transform

input.tw: bg-panel border border-rim rounded-md h-10 flex items-center text-body-md text-fg font-sans px-2 py-2 outline-none placeholder:text-fg-muted
input.focusTw: Global: src/app.css @layer base :focus uses ring-2 ring-focus ring-offset-2 ring-offset-canvas
rules: Fixed control height h-10 for single-line fields (matches Button normal size)
Placeholder text: text-fg-muted
Always pair with a label in label-sm style above
No paused state in yellow — omit dot when paused, show text status instead
No shadow
No colored borders
Border only when needed for separation: border border-fill

trigger.tw: w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-transparent text-fg/60 font-sans text-body-md

modal.header: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-card
rules: Backdrop is black/50 — no blur
Max-width: fit the content, not full-screen
Header uses sf-headline-sm for title
Close button is icon-only ghost variant

tabs.tabTw: font-normal tracking-stamped whitespace-nowrap uppercase transition-colors border-0 border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-label-md (panel mode)
rules: Active state pairs bottom border-active with a subtle bg-active/15 tint
Active (blue) is for selection — keyboard focus still uses the global focus ring (focus token)

bars.note: fg-dim gives ~3.5:1 contrast on canvas bg. rim gives ~2:1 — too low.

scribeWindow.description: Main floating panel. Menu-bar app, no Dock icon.
scribeWindow.header: flex items-center justify-between min-h-[52px] border-b border-card px-4 gap-3 flex-shrink-0 bg-panel
scribeWindow.rightCol: flex flex-col border-l border-card bg-panel p-2.5 min-h-0

settingsModal.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center
settingsModal.panel: bg-panel rounded-md w-[520px] max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col shadow-ambient

onboarding.description: First-run 4-step wizard. Full panel, no close button.
onboarding.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full p-6 gap-6 bg-panel

dictateBar.description: Compact menu-bar overlay for quick dictation.
dictateBar.container: bg-panel rounded-md shadow-ambient px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-3

prototypes.description: Exploratory UI — not shipped. Visual specs and playground mocks for review before implementation.

scribeRecordingBar.intent: Make Scribe recording impossible to forget when the main window is buried. Visually distinct from Dictate; full-width top band with recording accent — not a second corner pill.
scribeRecordingBar.platformNote: macOS does not allow apps to recolor the real menu bar. This is a full-width always-on-top window pinned to y=0 — the supported equivalent.

versusDictate.dictate: 240×48 rounded pill, top-right, bg-panel, neutral — quick dictation HUD (reuse shipped markup exactly in mocks)
versusDictate.scribe: Full primary-monitor width × 36px, y=0, bg-panel + destructive border accent — session recording chrome

window.label: scribe-recording-hud (internal)
window.geometry: width = primary monitor width; height = 36px; position (0, 0)
window.activationPolicy: Exclude from Dock sync like dictate window

scribeRecordingBar.container: w-full h-9 min-h-9 bg-panel border-b-2 border-destructive flex items-center gap-3 px-2 shrink-0 text-fg
scribeRecordingBar.containerAlt: Optional subtle tint: bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-destructive)_10%,var(--color-panel))] — same contrast, less loud than solid destructive fill

layout.leftClickTarget: button: SCRIBE label + RecordingStatusDot + single RecordingTimer — dot is the recording indicator; no separate Recording label; hover:bg-fill; opens/focuses Scribe window
layout.right: Stop and Save + IconButton discard — always present, including when Dictate HUD is also visible

tokens.contrastNote: Body text on panel meets fg on panel; destructive reserved for border + dot + discard

behavior.stop: invoke scribe_stop_and_save + open_scribe_window for processing UI
behavior.discard: scribe_cancel with same confirm rules as main window

openQuestions: Border only vs border + 10% destructive panel tint
Bar height 32px vs 40px on small screens

rules: No exclamation marks
No 'we' or 'our'
Labels are ALL CAPS with letter-spacing
Prose is sentence case
CTAs are Title Case (Stop and Save, Record Again)
Ellipsis for in-progress states (Starting…), not spinner copy
Error messages: lowercase, inline, no icon
